summary: Petitioner challenged the dismissal of his writ petition by the Allahabad High Court, seeking specific performance of Clause 12 of a 2001 Sale Deed for allotment of 10% plot area and rehabilitation bonus. The High Court dismissed the writ on grounds of delay, laches, and non-maintainability of a writ for specific performance of contract. The Supreme Court upheld the dismissal, holding that the writ was belated (filed after 11 years), remedy for contract enforcement lies in a civil suit, and no fresh cause of action arose from rejection of a delayed representation. Delay and laches barred relief.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
Section 6 of the U.P. Industrial Area Development Act, 1976
